lines.en: And I can't believe we're not going to be spending the rest of our lives together.
Forget what I said. I was babbling. Pick me!
No, you were right. You were right. I mean, I've got to give my marriage another chance.
No, no, no. I say you have to give your divorce another chance.
I don't care. I don't care!
Yeah, um, okay. I'm-I'm leaving now.
You can't leave. I have your shoe.
